title: The motif inventory as evidence surface
statement: The corpus adopts the folkloristic motif inventory — Thompson's Motif-Index as its principal instrument — as the neutral evidence surface on which its cross-cultural convergence claims must eventually be run: the systematic, controlled testing that the revision triggers of the memory-reading claims (0004, 0008 above all) call for has its infrastructure here, and reading the instrument itself — what a complete catalogue of the race's narrative content shows and refuses to say — is the corpus's speculative step beyond the cataloguer's own principled silence.

includes: The instrument adoption: the Motif-Index (and the mytheme apparatus generally) as the neutral surface for any systematic convergence test — the arbitrary-particulars and contact-free-tradition tests the memory claims' triggers demand
The neutrality condition, which is the adoption's whole value: the instrument was built refusing interpretation, which is exactly why results run on it can bind both ways
The reading of the instrument, speculative and labelled: what the catalogue's structure itself suggests, at the Filing Cabinet Explainer's strength and no further
excludes: Any claim that the inventory's existence or structure evidences the framework; the surface is where tests run, not a result
Motif-counting as argument; the independence-of-evidence principle (repeated instances of one stream are one datum) binds every use
Replacement of the per-claim evidence maps; the instrument serves tests, and results flow to the claims they test
The cataloguer's enlistment; Thompson's principled silence is preserved as his position

source_references.locator: The canon's testimony framing that makes a neutral cross-cultural instrument valuable to the corpus at all
The structuralist reading of motif patterns — the standing account of what inventories show without any memory

alternatives.statement: The Motif-Index's categories reflect its compiler's culture and sources; tests run on it inherit its collection biases, and neutrality is overstated.
What a complete narrative catalogue shows is the architecture of human minds (the structuralist account); the instrument's patterns need no referent and will never yield one.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0008 is revised or retired.
A systematic test is actually run on the surface — its result moves the tested claim and this record's status as infrastructure.
Public prose begins citing the inventory's structure as evidence, which this record excludes.
